title: Source record for unit-level movement and action
description: A source the fidelity database may cite. 'weight' fields are not used to average: the Reference Timeline takes the median of independent witnesses (rule R-MED) and keeps the rest as windows and alternates.

lag_days.description: days between the event and the writing: the retrospective flag is lag over 365

read.description: how much was read; never 'all' unless it was

text.description: local text the quotes are checked against
